seo.title: About
seo.description: Definica is an independently developed Ethereum protocol for staking, liquidity and borrowing, built on StakeWise V3 and Aave V3, mechanics in plain view.

hero.title:
No hidden 
mechanics.
hero.text: Definica is an independently developed, Ethereum-native protocol that connects pooled ETH staking, committed osETH liquidity and borrowing markets in one architecture. The aim is simple: help you understand what you hold, where each return comes from and what can go wrong.

why.title:
Questions that 
should be easy.
why.intro: Staked ETH can earn validator-backed rewards, but using it elsewhere onchain often means separate protocols, interfaces and accounting systems. That makes basic questions hard to answer.
questions: What position do I actually hold?
Where does each return come from?
Which protocol or contract manages it?
Which new risks appear when it enters another market?
why.answer: Definica connects these layers and keeps them legible. Validator performance, market supply return and incentives are shown as separate components, never combined into one headline number.

mission.title:
Mechanics you 
can follow.
mission.statement: Build useful ETH infrastructure without hiding the mechanics. You should be able to understand how a position is created, how your share is calculated, where each return originates, which external systems it depends on and which risks apply at every layer.

principles.title:
What we 
hold to.
principles.intro: Five principles shape every layer, from the contracts to the way the app shows a position.

items.title: Non-custodial
items.text: Your ETH sits in a StakeWise Vault governed by smart contracts, not with a company. That doesn't mean no permissions exist: the contracts are upgradeable through distinct roles, and those roles are described openly.

items.title: Every layer on its own
items.text: Staking, the Main Liquidity Module and the borrowing markets each run on their own contracts, and each layer names the contract that manages it, so a position can be traced from deposit to exit.

items.title: Nothing blended into one rate
items.text: Staking performance, Aave supply interest, lending income and incentives are reported as separate lines, next to any debt and its cost. No headline rate, and no guaranteed one.

items.title: Verifiable onchain
items.text: Role holders, fees and parameters can be read onchain, and the executed contract state prevails over the app and the docs.

items.title: Progress tied to readiness
items.text: Each module is enabled on its own once its evidence is in place: reviewed code, published rules and parameters, and deployed contracts that match them. Not on a fixed date.

builtOn.title:
Two established 
foundations.
builtOn.intro: Definica doesn't run its own staking network or its own money market. On Ethereum, it coordinates position accounting, funding, commitments, interest allocation, incentives and exits on top of two established providers.

items.name: StakeWise V3
items.text: StakeWise Vaults are isolated staking pools with shares-based accounting and permissionless Vault creation. They give Definica independent Vault administration, proportional accounting and the adoption of approved upgrades: a Vault's admin can upgrade only to implementations the StakeWise DAO has registered.

items.name: Aave V3 Ethereum
items.role: The osETH supply market and the funding loan
items.text: Supplying osETH to Aave V3 Ethereum mints aEthosETH, the receipt committed to the Main Liquidity Module. A funding loan, when you authorise one, is an ordinary Aave V3 borrow and follows Aave's rules.

link.title: The reading list behind the mechanics

layers.title:
Three layers, 
each on its own.
layers.intro: Each layer can be used on its own, and each module is activated separately, with its own contracts and parameters.

items.title: Staking
items.text: Pool ETH in a dedicated StakeWise Vault and keep a proportional share, recorded by DefinicaCore.

items.title: Main Liquidity Module
items.text: Supply osETH to Aave V3, hold aEthosETH and commit it for a fixed duration, with optional financing.

items.title: Borrowing markets
items.text: Borrow a supported asset against approved ETH-correlated collateral, under rules set per market.

safety.title: Definica never asks for your keys
safety.text: Never share a private key, seed phrase or recovery phrase. For security research, write to security@definica.com before any testing that could affect users, assets, availability or confidential information.
